name: Kevin Cecil
source:
Kevin Cecil is William's butler of many years, though in fact he is the Archangel of Repentance and Cruelty, Uriel. 
Uriel took on the position of the school priest at William's school to make sure the demons don't get to him. He's also a gambling addict.
